features: Real objectives are generated for every wave based on its realm: defend a destructible wardstone, purge enemy-summoning portals, charge a Moonlight Shrine or activate two Void Seals.

Wardstone attackers can damage both the protected stone and nearby player; portals are auto-targetable and can be destroyed with ordinary attacks; shrines reward timed attack/speed blessings; the throne periodically pulses damage outside its telegraphed safe center.

Two distinct bosses every fourth wave: Void Monarch on Wave 4 and Void Tyrant on Wave 8, each with increased salvo complexity when entering the second phase; Void Tyrant is protected by linked Void Seals until both are awakened.
Optional realm objectives earn additional Renown at completed-run game-over, along with score; Hall of Legends tracks cumulative completed expeditions.
Two rare expedition/boss blueprint relics unlock after completing two realm quests or killing two realm bosses, and can then be forged and equipped using the original Armory.
Original Canvas2D runic objective graphics, health and charge meters, off-screen directional objective cues, boss-phase telegraphs, and accessible realm quest HUD for desktop and iPhone.
All prior v1.4 champion powers, weapon evolutions, enemy AI, Armory purchases, existing localStorage saves, PROXIMUS personal media and game-specific offline PWA cache boundaries preserved.
privacy: Scores only in this game's localStorage; no access to Asset Alchemist video files.
